# mux_playback_restrictions (Data Source)

Lists every playback restriction of the environment, with its rules. Handy for finding the ID of a restriction to import, and for checking what an import will adopt.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mux_playback_restrictions" "all" {}

# The ID and domains of every restriction, e.g. to pick the one to import.
output "playback_restrictions" {
  value = {
    for r in data.mux_playback_restrictions.all.restrictions :
    r.id => {
      allowed_domains   = r.referrer.allowed_domains
      allow_no_referrer = r.referrer.allow_no_referrer
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `restrictions` (Attributes List) The playback restrictions, in the order Mux lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))

<a id="nestedatt--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the restriction was created, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `id` (String) Playback restriction ID.
- `referrer` (Attributes) Which referring domains may play the videos. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions--referrer))
- `updated_at` (String) When the restriction was last changed, in seconds since the Unix epoch.
- `user_agent` (Attributes) Which user agents may play the videos. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions--user_agent))

<a id="nestedatt--restrictions--referrer"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions.referrer`

Read-Only:

- `allow_no_referrer` (Boolean) Whether requests without a `Referer` header are allowed.
- `allowed_domains` (Set of String) Domains allowed to play the videos. Empty denies every domain.


<a id="nestedatt--restrictions--user_agent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions.user_agent`

Read-Only:

- `allow_high_risk_user_agent` (Boolean) Whether user agents Mux considers high risk are allowed.
- `allow_no_user_agent` (Boolean) Whether requests without a `User-Agent` header are allowed.
